commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; expected=0ac9a5306f9af7f914a178e16dffc70dfabf01bd; actual=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo HEAD=$actual; test "$actual" = "$expected"; /usr/bin/python3 scripts/check_runtime_config_ssot.py; root=$(pwd); cat > /tmp/growbox-eink-defaults.cmake <<EOF
set(GROWBOX_APP_CLIMATE_V6_REAL_INPUTS 1)
include("$root/config/runtime/GrowboxRuntimeConfig.cmake")
configure_file("$root/src/climate/runtime/RuntimeBuildConfig.h.in" "/tmp/growbox-eink-RuntimeBuildConfig.h" @ONLY)
EOF
cmake -P /tmp/growbox-eink-defaults.cmake; grep -F 'inline constexpr bool kEinkDisplayEnabled = 0 != 0;' /tmp/growbox-eink-RuntimeBuildConfig.h; grep -F 'inline constexpr int kEinkCsGpio = -1;' /tmp/growbox-eink-RuntimeBuildConfig.h; grep -F 'inline constexpr int kEinkDcGpio = -1;' /tmp/growbox-eink-RuntimeBuildConfig.h; grep -F 'inline constexpr int kEinkRstGpio = -1;' /tmp/growbox-eink-RuntimeBuildConfig.h; grep -F 'inline constexpr int kEinkBusyGpio = -1;' /tmp/growbox-eink-RuntimeBuildConfig.h; ! grep -F '@GROWBOX_EINK' /tmp/growbox-eink-RuntimeBuildConfig.h; cat > /tmp/growbox-eink-missing.cmake <<EOF
set(GROWBOX_APP_CLIMATE_V6_REAL_INPUTS 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DISPLAY_ENABLED 1)
include("$root/config/runtime/GrowboxRuntimeConfig.cmake")
EOF
if cmake -P /tmp/growbox-eink-missing.cmake >/tmp/growbox-eink-missing.out 2>&1; then echo expected_missing_pin_failure; exit 1; fi; grep -F 'must be an assigned non-negative GPIO' /tmp/growbox-eink-missing.out; cat > /tmp/growbox-eink-valid.cmake <<EOF
set(GROWBOX_APP_CLIMATE_V6_REAL_INPUTS 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DISPLAY_ENABLED 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_CS_GPIO 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DC_GPIO 2)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_RST_GPIO 3)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_BUSY_GPIO 4)
include("$root/config/runtime/GrowboxRuntimeConfig.cmake")
EOF
cmake -P /tmp/growbox-eink-valid.cmake; cat > /tmp/growbox-eink-i2c-conflict.cmake <<EOF
set(GROWBOX_APP_CLIMATE_V6_REAL_INPUTS 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DISPLAY_ENABLED 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_CS_GPIO 8)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DC_GPIO 2)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_RST_GPIO 3)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_BUSY_GPIO 4)
include("$root/config/runtime/GrowboxRuntimeConfig.cmake")
EOF
if cmake -P /tmp/growbox-eink-i2c-conflict.cmake >/tmp/growbox-eink-i2c-conflict.out 2>&1; then echo expected_i2c_conflict_failure; exit 1; fi; grep -F 'e-ink display and I2C enabled together' /tmp/growbox-eink-i2c-conflict.out; cat > /tmp/growbox-eink-duplicate.cmake <<EOF
set(GROWBOX_APP_CLIMATE_V6_REAL_INPUTS 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DISPLAY_ENABLED 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_CS_GPIO 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DC_GPIO 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_RST_GPIO 3)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_BUSY_GPIO 4)
include("$root/config/runtime/GrowboxRuntimeConfig.cmake")
EOF
if cmake -P /tmp/growbox-eink-duplicate.cmake >/tmp/growbox-eink-duplicate.out 2>&1; then echo expected_duplicate_pin_failure; exit 1; fi; grep -F 'e-ink display control pins' /tmp/growbox-eink-duplicate.out; cat > /tmp/growbox-eink-wrong-mode.cmake <<EOF
set(GROWBOX_APP_CLIMATE_V6_REAL_INPUTS 0)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DISPLAY_ENABLED 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_CS_GPIO 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DC_GPIO 2)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_RST_GPIO 3)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_BUSY_GPIO 4)
include("$root/config/runtime/GrowboxRuntimeConfig.cmake")
EOF
if cmake -P /tmp/growbox-eink-wrong-mode.cmake >/tmp/growbox-eink-wrong-mode.out 2>&1; then echo expected_wrong_mode_failure; exit 1; fi; grep -F 'GROWBOX_EINK_DISPLAY_ENABLED requires' /tmp/growbox-eink-wrong-mode.out; grep -F 'GROWBOX_APP_MODE=climate-v6-real-inputs' /tmp/growbox-eink-wrong-mode.out; cat > /tmp/growbox-eink-rf-conflict.cmake <<EOF
set(GROWBOX_APP_CLIMATE_V6_REAL_INPUTS 1)
set(GROWBOX_RF433_LOOPBACK_ENABLED 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DISPLAY_ENABLED 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_CS_GPIO 14)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DC_GPIO 2)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_RST_GPIO 3)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_BUSY_GPIO 4)
include("$root/config/runtime/GrowboxRuntimeConfig.cmake")
EOF
if cmake -P /tmp/growbox-eink-rf-conflict.cmake >/tmp/growbox-eink-rf-conflict.out 2>&1; then echo expected_rf_conflict_failure; exit 1; fi; grep -F 'e-ink display and RF433 enabled together' /tmp/growbox-eink-rf-conflict.out; cat > /tmp/growbox-eink-sd-conflict.cmake <<EOF
set(GROWBOX_APP_CLIMATE_V6_REAL_INPUTS 1)
set(GROWBOX_STAGE27_SD_ENABLED 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DISPLAY_ENABLED 1)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_CS_GPIO 10)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DC_GPIO 2)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_RST_GPIO 3)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_BUSY_GPIO 4)
include("$root/config/runtime/GrowboxRuntimeConfig.cmake")
EOF
if cmake -P /tmp/growbox-eink-sd-conflict.cmake >/tmp/growbox-eink-sd-conflict.out 2>&1; then echo expected_sd_conflict_failure; exit 1; fi; grep -F 'e-ink display control and SD enabled together' /tmp/growbox-eink-sd-conflict.out; bash scripts/test_display_host.sh; git diff --check; test -z "$(git status --short)"
